name: sj-svalbard-income-tax
description: Calculate ordinary individual income and wealth tax on Svalbard for 2026. Distinguishes gross salary withholding, separately assessed sole-trader profit and ordinary investment, rental and capital-gain income. Covers residents, qualifying nonresidents, the conditional newcomer restriction, deductions and losses, the shared twelve-basic-amount band, personal capital-income allowance and ordinary net-wealth computation. Explains return and advance-payment obligations, penalties and mainland or foreign source allocation, with two independently reproducible examples. Use for Svalbard personal tax, sole proprietor, investment income, share gains, rental income and wealth tax. Jan Mayen and specialist regimes are outside scope. This source-cited draft requires professional review before a filing position is taken.
